blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The bodies of the two children and their 60-year-old grandmother who died in a landslide in Barangay Pulangbato, Cebu City, are lying in wake at the barangay gym as of Sunday, October 11. The three family members were killed when a landslide buried their home in Sitio Kandarong Riverside on Friday, October 9. The victims were a five-year-old boy, his six-year-old cousin, and their grandmother. The children’s 38-year-old mother survived the landslide and was brought to a hospital.
